title: csv_find_empty_fields
prompt:
Given this CSV, identify each row with an empty field. Use the value in the ID column, not the physical row number, and report each finding as ID=<value>, Column=<header>. Return only the findings, one per line.
ID,Name,Email,Phone,Country
A101,Alice,alice@example.com,555-1234,UK
B205,Bob,,555-5678,US
C309,Carol,carol@example.com,,CA
D412,Dave,dave@example.com,555-9999,AU
